articles.summary: Landmark Agreement with GE Vernova and Baker Hughes supports the development of over 10 GW of new Island-Mode power capacity across sites owned or controlled by Venture Global Leverages existing team and execution capabilities to enable rapid deployment of adjacent, behind-the-wall, large-scale data centers with no reliance on the public electric grid demand or extra cost to consumers Staged, market-driven expansion advances Venture Global’s critical energy infrastructure strategy in a disciplined manner and positions the Company to facilitate power and compute capacity at gigawatt-scale on an attractive timeline Venture Global, Inc. (NYSE: VG) today announced it has entered into power and grid frame agreements with GE Vernova and Baker Hughes Energy Services for up to 16 new, 720 MW power island units and associated power transformer equipment, supporting the continued expansion of its existing behind-the-meter, Island-Mode industrial power network that is not reliant on the grid.
articles.title: Venture Global Secures New Agreements to Support Expansion of Existing Grid-Independent Power Network

articles.summary: Today, Venture Global, Inc. (NYSE: VG) and ConocoPhillips (NYSE: COP) announced a new, long-term Sales and Purchase Agreement (SPA) for liquefied natural gas (LNG). Under the SPA, ConocoPhillips will buy 1.0 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) of LNG from Venture Global for 20 years, starting in 2030. "Venture Global is proud to welcome ConocoPhillips, one of the world's leading energy companies, as a long-term partner," said Venture Global CEO Mike Sabel . "This agreement reflects continued market confidence in our proven ability to deliver reliable, low-cost U.S. LNG quickly and at scale. We look forward to supporting ConocoPhillips' growing global LNG portfolio for decades to come." About Venture Global Venture Global is an American producer and exporter of low-cost U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) with over 100 MTPA of capacity in production, construction, or development. articles.summary: Venture Global, Inc. (“Venture Global”) (NYSE: VG) announced today that it plans to issue its earnings release with respect to third quarter 2026 financial results before market open on Tuesday, November 10, 2026. Venture Global will host a conference call for investors and analysts beginning at 9:00 am Eastern Time (ET) on November 10, 2026, to discuss first quarter results. A listen-only webcast of the conference call and accompanying slide presentation will be available at Venture Global’s Investor Relations website HERE . After the conclusion of the conference call, a replay will be made available on the Venture Global website.
